response.rationale: C1 is the append-only completion of R4 with an anatomy modifier, so it preserves the MPNST core (atypical perivascular spindle cells, mitoses, nerve-sheath context, S100/neurofilament/CD56 IHC) while adding explicitly supported bladder localization from diffuse bladder-wall thickening and cystoprostatectomy. R4 is diagnostically accurate but less complete because it lacks the bladder-specific modifier. No contradictory raw spans are present.
